sessionName: Week 6 - CRM, forecasting and gain-share tracking
summary: George Berrington reviewed systems with Paul and Rebecca. Pipeline sits in a shared spreadsheet and gain-share income is forecast by hand. We agreed to move to a CRM and to forecast gain-share separately from fixed-fee work.

discussion.keyPoints: Pipeline is tracked in a shared Excel file; Rebecca maintains it. There is no CRM.
Paul said gain-share income is hard to predict because savings are verified quarterly. Last year actual gain-share income was 22% below forecast.
Contact data is spread across Outlook address books; no record of which PE house owns each client.

recommendations.recommendation: Implement Pipedrive for 8 users with the five agreed stages by the end of next month.
Forecast gain-share income separately, at 70% of client-verified savings, on a quarterly cycle.
Record the PE owner and annual third-party spend on every company record.
Build a monthly board dashboard of fees, gain-share receivables and pipeline.

actions.action: Set up the Pipedrive account and import the pipeline

nextFocus: Align marketing campaigns to the CFO proposition.
nextPreparation: Rebecca to gather existing marketing content and web analytics.

tests.question: How will we forecast gain-share income?
